prototypeScope: V1.20 delta package on one Orange plate: the battery backpack frame refitted to the Swann 39 switch, its cap, and the rear converter box cap with 3.0 mm screw-head floors (V1.19, never printed, folded in here).
knownFitBoundary: Shells need the V1.9 rear pack (its shoulder bars); Shawn confirmed it is fitted. The pack bar has no printed pilot: drill dia 1.6 through the shell roof hole with a tape flag 7.0 mm from the tip. Driver above each pack screw on the finished robot: 57.8 mm to the lower head shell. Cap: closes with the same three ROBOTIS M2.6 x 6 as the V1.9 cap; the A7Z rests on the four round pads and screws on with the Pi screws (E-pi-01..04). Face: the camera takes 4 x M2 x 4 into 2.4 mm of thread (below the 3.5 mm target, face-a7z/README.md) and the eye trim 2 x M2 x 6 from the face back; the image needs a 90 deg rotation in software. Thighs: same geometry as the 10/1 thighs; fitting them means taking both legs apart and re-reading the joint zeros (guide/firmware/mac/pose_snapshot.py). Battery backpack: built for the Tattu 2S 650 listing size (57 x 31 x 12 mm) in a 58 x 32 x 13 pocket; measure the pack before printing if it may be larger. It mounts on the same four cover screws as the rear converter box (swap one for the other); cap 3 x M2 x 8, fixing 4 x M2 x 6. V1.19 caps: the box cap takes the same four M2 x 10 as V1.17 and fits the printed V1.17 frame; tighten until the cap sits on the rim and stop, the heads bear on printed floors. V1.20 frame: the Swann 39 switch snaps up through the 12.3 x 27.5 mm floor hole from the rocker pocket; wire the switch lead before inserting it.
processOverrideReason: No process overrides: V1.20 carries only the Orange plate.

parts.changeReason: V1.20: the V1.19 layout F cap, unprinted, carried unchanged. the V1.17 layout F cap with each of its four screw-head floors thickened from 1.0 to 3.0 mm. The printed V1.17 cap's two low floors tore into open holes when it was taken off (Shawn 2026-10-15, IMG_7004). The floors grow 2.0 mm forward (column fronts x -53.1 low, -52.6 top), so the head seats (x -56.1 / -55.6), the four stock M2 x 10 and the thread engagement (3.9 / 4.6 mm) are unchanged; the +y low column is flattened to 0.5 mm above the USB-C socket. Gaps: 1.5 mm to the 5991 PCB, 1.25 mm to the 7 V board, cap to boards 0.287 mm (unchanged walls). Evidence: back-plate/layout-F/raycast_cap_screws.json and post_build.json.

The floor hole is now the Swann cutout 12.3 x 27.5 mm (Swann catalogue 27.4 x 12.3 mm for the same family), the rocker pocket 14.4 mm wide for the 13.8 mm flange, and the battery pocket starts 0.3 mm behind the measured body, so the box is 27.45 mm deep (V1.18 26.75).
